change_summary: Compress get_order_details tool-result blobs in history to only order_id, status, and item options/prices, keeping every order (no truncation).
reason_for_change: get_order_details blobs are the largest carried payload and are re-sent verbatim every turn, dominating input-token cost. Prior truncation dropped whole older blobs that were still referenced and broke success; field-level compression preserves every order's decision-relevant fields (order_id, status, item options/prices) while removing address/metadata bloat, cutting re-sent input tokens per turn and lowering mean cost while holding success.
reason_accepted_or_rejected: rejected: first proxy run did not improve — crossed success guardrail: pass_rate 0.7500 < floor 0.7521
hypothesis: The get_order_details result blobs are the single largest carried-context payload and get re-sent every turn; compressing (not fully truncating) each tool-result to only the fields the agent needs — order_id, status, and item options/prices — will cut input tokens without dropping information the agent uses.
